name: C4 Architecture Diagram Generation
description: Extend 'fade map' to generate interactive C4 architecture diagrams as a self-contained HTML file. Uses Mermaid.js for rendering, requiring no external dependencies at view time. Provides visual representation of system context, containers, and components detected during codebase analysis.

userStories.title: Generate System Context diagram
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade map to generate a C4 System Context diagram showing my system and its external dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: fade map --diagram generates architecture.html in project root
HTML file is self-contained with embedded Mermaid.js CDN link
Diagram shows the system as central element
External systems detected from dependencies (databases, APIs, auth providers) shown as external actors
Users/actors inferred from framework type (web app, CLI, API server)
Relationships labeled with interaction type (uses, reads, writes)

userStories.title: Generate Container diagram
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a C4 Container diagram showing the major containers in my application
acceptanceCriteria: Container diagram shows application containers (web app, API, workers, etc.)
Database containers detected from ORM/driver dependencies
Message queues detected from queue dependencies (Redis, RabbitMQ, SQS)
External service integrations shown as external containers
Technology labels included (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, etc.)
Container diagram accessible via tab/toggle in HTML output

userStories.title: Generate Component diagram
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a C4 Component diagram showing the major components within my application
acceptanceCriteria: Components detected from directory structure (routes/, controllers/, services/, models/)
Component relationships inferred from import patterns where detectable
Components grouped by architectural layer (presentation, business, data)
Each component labeled with its responsibility based on directory/file naming
Component diagram accessible via tab/toggle in HTML output

userStories.title: Interactive HTML output
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the HTML diagram to be interactive and self-contained for easy sharing
acceptanceCriteria: Single HTML file with no external dependencies except CDN (works offline after first load)
Tabs or buttons to switch between Context, Container, and Component views
Zoom and pan controls for large diagrams
Dark/light mode toggle
Export to PNG button using Mermaid's built-in export
Generated timestamp and FADE version shown in footer

userStories.title: Diagram customization options
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to customize what's included in the generated diagrams
acceptanceCriteria: --diagram=context generates only System Context diagram
--diagram=container generates Context + Container diagrams
--diagram=component generates all three levels (default)
--diagram-output=PATH allows custom output location
--diagram-title='My System' sets custom system name
Options documented in fade map --help

userStories.title: Mermaid DSL export
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to export the raw Mermaid diagram code for use in documentation
acceptanceCriteria: --diagram-format=mermaid outputs .mmd files instead of HTML
Generates context.mmd, container.mmd, component.mmd as separate files
Files can be embedded in README.md or other markdown docs
Includes comments in .mmd files explaining each section
Format documented in fade map --help

technicalNotes.approach: Generate Mermaid C4 diagram syntax from codebase analysis results. Use Mermaid's native C4 diagram support (C4Context, C4Container, C4Component).
technicalNotes.mermaidC4Syntax: Mermaid supports C4 natively: Person(), System(), Container(), Component(), Rel(), SystemDb(), SystemQueue()
technicalNotes.htmlTemplate: Embed Mermaid via CDN, include tab switching logic, zoom controls via CSS transform. Single file ~50KB uncompressed.

detectionHeuristics.databases: Look for pg, mysql, mongodb, prisma, sequelize, typeorm, mongoose in dependencies
detectionHeuristics.queues: Look for redis, ioredis, bull, amqplib, sqs in dependencies
detectionHeuristics.auth: Look for passport, auth0, firebase-admin, jsonwebtoken in dependencies
detectionHeuristics.storage: Look for aws-sdk, @google-cloud/storage, multer in dependencies

technicalNotes.limitations: Component relationships are best-effort based on directory structure. Deep import analysis would require AST parsing which is out of scope for shell-based approach.
technicalNotes.futureEnhancement: Could add --deep-diagram flag that uses Claude to analyze actual code relationships for more accurate component diagrams.
